Description

Founded by Markus Staiger.

Trivia

Originally called Blast Records.

The label's first release was a vinyl compilation called Senseless Death, which featured a plethora of US hardcore bands, including Attitude, Sacred Denial, Impulse Manslaughter, and others. Only 1000 copies were pressed (catalogue # NB 001).
